narr: A weak area of low pressure moved along a stalled frontal boundary in northern Virginia. This spawned showers and thunderstorms that resulted in localized amounts of two to four inches of rain.
ev: VA-244 Columbia Pike was blocked by high water at South Greenbrier Street. Other streets impacted by high water nearby.
Four Mile Run and Wren Branch rapidly rose out of their banks, with 6 to 8 inches of water flowing across trails.
VA-123 Chain Bridge Road was blocked due to several inches of water flowing across the road near I-66 Custis Memorial Parkway.

The stream gauge on Accotink Creek at Strathmeade Springs reached minor flood stage. Woodburn Road was covered by approximately six inches of water at its lowest point. Portions of the Cross County Trail were also flooded.
